_about.captured: 2026-10-13 from app.sanoflow.io (Al Das workspace), read-only, by fetching the logged-in app's page HTML and reading Wappler Server Connect declarations (dmx-serverconnect url, dmx-param:*, serverconnect-form field names) and the page's i18n key vocabulary. No API was called, no record data, names, phones or message text were captured. Endpoint/field names describe behaviour; do not copy Sanoflow naming into Pulse.
_about.method: REA-style passive web observation (equivalent of rea inspect-web-page + analyze-web-bundle on the server-rendered HTML)

frontend_stack: JointJS flow canvas, jQuery QueryBuilder, JSONEditor 9.10, jquery-cron-quartz + cronstrue
AG Grid Enterprise + AG Charts Enterprise, Chart.js, ApexCharts

node_types_observed: ask_a_question(question_type: text|number|multiple_choice|both; answer_validation regex; store_answer; request_contact_info)
send_ai_message / ai_action (intents[] with intent_label + intent_prompt, system_prompt, source_group (KB scope), tone, send_ai_generated_response_before_executing_next_step)
update_contact_field(field incl. opt_in_promotions/opt_out_promotions, label set/remove, tag add/remove/remove_all, gender, nationality, dob)
api_action(request_url, method, headers, json body, store_response)
send_notification(notification_type, alert type, category, team, message)
send_meta_event(event_name e.g. lead|purchase|addpaymentinfo, amount, currency, event_json)
set message status / label by message_id (new_status, set_label, label_name)
trigger_condition_fields: source (channel, ads, website, booking page, call centre)
builder_validation_messages: max file sizes per media type
flow_engine.flow_runtime: per-contact run log with steps (/api/workflow/log/all, /log/step) and a manual stop (stop-workflow)
